Booking Holdings Romania - Frontend Software Engineer - Pipeline
jobs.description:
Undelucram.ro on behalf of:
BOOKING HOLDINGS ROMANIA SRL
Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania and was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of our Brands.
As part of our Booking Holdings Romania team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of the world’s leading provider of online travel, with a mission of making it easier for everyone to experience the world through six-primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, OpenTable and Rentalcars.com.
Role Description
The Frontend Software Engineer designs, builds, and evolves scalable, high-quality web applications and user experiences that power Booking Holdings’ high-traffic platforms, ensuring performance, accessibility, reliability, and usability for millions of travelers worldwide. Success means owning the full software lifecycle from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and production support, while raising the engineering bar through mentorship, code reviews, and technical leadership across teams. The role exists to drive frontend engineering excellence and modern web architecture within the Bucharest Centre of Excellence, supporting Booking Holdings’ consumer brands by providing specialized engineering talent and best practices that accelerate delivery across the organization.
This role provides a hybrid way of working with an onsite presence of 2 days/week.
Key Job Responsibilities And Duties
Translates product and design requirements into fully functioning front-end features across desktop and mobile web, following established design systems and engineering standards, in order to deliver high-quality user experiences to millions of customers.
Builds, tests, and iterates on web experiences using modern front-end technologies, aligned with performance, accessibility, and maintainability best practices, in order to ensure reliable, bug-free product experiences.
Owns front-end solutions end-to-end, from idea and implementation through release and post-launch monitoring, guided by team engineering practices, in order to ensure quality, performance, and long-term maintainability.
Applies experimentation, A/B testing, and analytics to product development work, in line with data-driven product principles, in order to validate ideas and drive measurable improvements for end users.
Collaborates with designers, back-end developers, product managers, copywriters, and user researchers on feature discovery and delivery, within an agile team setup, in order to shape and ship well-rounded product experiences.
Contributes to engineering standards, code reviews, hiring, and onboarding within the broader engineering organisation, aligned with internal guidelines and ways of working, in order to raise code quality and support the growth of the team.
Role Qualifications And Requirements
Bachelor’s degree and 3-5 years of relevant experience
Knowledge
Strong knowledge of core front-end technologies, including JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Working knowledge of modern front-end ecosystems such as React and TypeScript, with familiarity with Node.js considered a plus.
Understanding of web performance, accessibility, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility principles.
Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and analytics-informed product development.
Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git) and modern collaborative development workflows.
Understanding of testing practices for front-end code, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Awareness of agile ways of working and product development lifecycles in a commercial, product-led environment.
Skills
Ability to translate product and design requirements into functional, high-quality front-end features.
Skill in writing high-performance, reusable, and maintainable front-end code.
Proficiency in troubleshooting browser compatibility issues and complex front-end implementation problems.
Strong product sense, with the ability to advocate for the end-user experience during design and implementation.
Ability to interpret experimentation and analytics data to inform front-end decisions and iterations.
Effective written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across disciplines.
Skill in reviewing peers' code and providing constructive, actionable feedback.
Abilities
Ability to take ownership of front-end work from idea through implementation, release, and iteration.
Ability to collaborate effectively with designers, back-end developers, product managers, copywriters, and user researchers in an agile setting.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a pragmatic approach to trade-offs on quality, performance, and delivery.
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver reliably in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
Adaptability to evolving front-end technologies, tools, and product needs.
Commitment to continuous learning and to raising engineering standards within the team.
Benefits & Perks
Contributing to a high-scale, complex, world renowned product and seeing real-time impact of your work on millions of travelers worldwide
Working in a fast-paced and performance driven culture
Technical, behavioral and interpersonal competence advancement via on-the-job opportunities, experimental projects, hackathons, conferences and active community participation
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Vast amounts of data to validate your ideas and the opportunity to experiment with real users
Booking Holdings is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.
Pre-Employment Screening
If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (gn) - Location Bucharest
jobs.description:
Your job at DKV Mobility? As part of a leading European B2B platform for on-the-road payment solutions, you will work in an exciting environment. Our tasks are defined by our Purpose: To drive the transition towards an efficient and sustainable future of mobility. We offer you numerous opportunities to help shape the mobility of tomorrow in a dynamic and agile environment. Our approximately 2,700 employees throughout Europe are united by a common passion: to give their best every day for our customers in more than 50 countries. True to our claim: You drive, we care. Become part of our diverse, dedicated and unique team!
What you can expect
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and debugging responsive web and mobile applications for the company. Using Angular & JavaScript this candidate will be able to translate user and business needs into functional frontend design.
Key Responsibilities
You will work as part of an agile development team with members from Romania, Germany, and Ukraine to design, estimate, develop and implement software solutions that satisfy the business requirements.
You will work closely with the team on a comprehensive Java-based product consisting of web front ends, back-end APIs, and standalone microservices, using Azure cloud.
You will be required to participate in the FE Community of Practice, identify and come up with best practices that would push us towards building a great end user experience for our DKV customer base
You will be part of the Customer Product Services organization, which is focused on delivering high-quality software services for the DKV customers, which is reachable via www (web).
Responsible for planning, development and operations of web applications for DKV products
Developing client-based web frontends with Angular of Java web applications and microservices for application servers and cloud environments
Responsible for applications and porting to other infrastructures (primarily cloud environments)
Create unit tests to ensure code is functioning as expected and well written documentation
Part of scrum team
Development of functions to improve usability
What makes you stand out
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science
4+ years' experience in frontend development
Familiarity using Scrum/Agile development methodologies is a plus
Experience building object-oriented web applications in JavaScript, Angular 16+,
We are looking forward to your application and to applicants who enrich our diverse culture! Regardless of age, gender, origin and sexual identity and orientation. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if equally qualified. This position can be full-time or part-time (min. 30h/week). DKV Mobility is looking for the best talents and knows that these are not always available on a full-time basis. Many of our employees work part-time or in flexible working models. Please talk to us about the flexibility you need during the application process.
Why DKV Mobility? Here are five good reasons...
At DKV Mobility, we are team players - because we are only successful together!
#teamofteams
You should feel welcome with us from the very beginning!
We've Been Growing For About 90 Years
How we do it? We keep adapting our products and business model to meet changing customer needs. That's how we stay mobile and master every challenge the future holds.
There are also many other good reasons to work at DKV Mobility. For example, we offer you comprehensive company health management, parent-child offices (from 2023) and support you in leasing your eBike through our partner Jobrad!
We attach great importance to work-life balance.
We stand for the compatibility of family and career! That's why we offer flexible working hours and family-friendly working time models. In addition, we rely on a balanced mix of on-site meetings and home office.
We support you in your development
We offer you optimal conditions to familiarize yourself so that you can quickly find your way around and become a part of the team! To further your personal development, we offer you access to a modern learning environment - independent of time and location. This way you can also face the challenges of tomorrow!
We are committed to a net-zero future
After reaching our Green Pledge climate target in 2023 by reducing carbon emissions in our own business operations by 50.4% compared to the base year 2019, we set ourselves ambitious net-zero climate targets. The targets have been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative. By 2050, DKV Mobility commits to reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions across the value chain from a 2022 base year. You want to take climate action? Follow us on our road to net-zero.
We are a certified employer
Our employees trust us. As an employer, we regularly receive awards from independent institutes, e.g. as Top Employer Germany and as Great Place to Work!
Did you know that we have received several awards as an employer in recent years?
Have we made you curious? Then we are looking forward to your application! If you still have open questions then please contact
Zaharia Alexandra
via Alexandra.Zaharia@dkv-mobility.com.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer - DealWise @ING Hubs Romania
jobs.description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING's software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca.
Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
Here's a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:
At ING, we're building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agree
The Mission
We are seeking a skilled Frontend Developer with expertise in web components and JavaScript frameworks to join our dynamic team. As a Frontend Developer, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing user interfaces for our web applications. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in frontend development, a deep understanding of web technologies, and a passion for creating seamless and visually appealing user experiences.
Your day to day
Frontend Development & Web Components
Develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable frontend applications.
Build modular Web Components using technologies such as Lit and modern JavaScript frameworks.
Translate UI/UX designs into responsive, high-quality user interfaces.
Contribute to shared component libraries and frontend standards.
Promote coding best practices, maintainability, and consistency across applications.
Microfrontend Architecture
Design, develop, and maintain solutions within a microfrontend architecture.
Ensure seamless integration between independently developed frontend applications.
Support modularization, scalability, and independent delivery of frontend capabilities.
Contribute to frontend architecture evolution and technical decision-making.
State Management
Implement and maintain scalable state management solutions using Redux or similar technologies.
Define effective patterns for data flow and asynchronous operations.
Ensure predictable application behavior and maintainable state structures.
Support communication across frontend modules and applications.
Accessibility & User Experience
Develop accessible user interfaces that comply with WCAG and WAI-ARIA guidelines.
Perform accessibility reviews and remediation activities.
Ensure compatibility with assistive technologies.
Advocate for inclusive design and accessibility best practices.
Performance Optimization
Optimize application performance and loading times.
Identify and resolve rendering bottlenecks, memory issues, and performance concerns.
Improve Core Web Vitals and overall user experience.
Continuously monitor and enhance frontend performance.
Testing & Quality Engineering
Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Collaborate with QA engineers to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Support automated testing practices.
Participate in code reviews and quality improvement initiatives.
Azure DevOps & CI/CD
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Automate build, testing, quality validation, and deployment processes.
Manage source control, build pipelines, release workflows, and artifacts.
Support deployment and release activities across multiple environments.
Troubleshoot build and deployment issues and drive continuous improvement of delivery processes.
AI-Assisted Development
Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered engineering assistants to improve productivity.
Use AI-assisted development techniques for coding, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.
Validate and review AI-generated outputs to ensure compliance with quality, security, and maintainability standards.
Contribute to the adoption of responsible AI-assisted development practices within the team.
Collaboration & Technical Leadership
Collaborate with developers, architects, designers, product owners, and QA engineers.
Participate in architectural discussions and technical design reviews.
Share knowledge and contribute to engineering communities and best practices.
Support junior and mid-level engineers through mentoring and technical guidance.
Promote a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
What you'll bring to the team
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience developing modern frontend applications.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Hands-on experience with Lit, React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar frontend frameworks.
Strong experience building and maintaining Web Components.
Solid experience with Redux or similar state management solutions.
Experience working within microfrontend architectures.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
Experience implementing accessibility standards (WCAG, WAI-ARIA).
Experience with frontend testing frameworks and automated testing practices.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Adobe Analytics
Experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development tools.
Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization techniques.
Experience with Git-based development workflows.
If you have a passion for building innovative and user-friendly interfaces using the latest web technologies, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of our web applications and providing users with exceptional digital experiences.
If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us:
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.
Role Summary:
LSEG is seeking a dynamic and hands-on Frontend Engineer to join a high-performing engineering team in delivering strategic applications for our flagship LSEG Workspace platform. This role is responsible for designing, building, and optimising high‑performance, customer‑facing applications for the LSEG Workspace platform. You will work closely with product managers, UX designers and product owners to deliver exceptional user experiences while contributing to architectural decisions and advancing engineering excellence across the organisation.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Hands-on Engineering: Design and implement high‑quality, scalable frontend applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frameworks.
Deliver features end‑to‑end, including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
Contribute to frontend modernisation initiatives.
Maintain high coding standards, testing practices, and development automation.
Collaboration: Work with Product and UX teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Collaborate with backend, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration and reliable delivery.
Operational Excellence: Contribute to improving reliability, performance, observability, and scalability across applications.
Support enhancements in tools, processes, and engineering best practices.
"Can-do" attitude and the ability and openness to learn new technologies.
What You’ll Bring:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
Good proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks (ideally around 4-5 years of previous experience).
Experience with full‑stack development is nice to have (any modern backend framework or language).
Proven experience delivering complex software products in Agile environments.
Strong understanding of web performance, UI architecture, and accessibility.
Excellent problem‑solving and debugging abilities.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders.
Experience working with distributed and cross‑functional engineering teams.
Benefits:
We are looking for intellectually curious people, passionate about the bigger picture of how technology industry is evolving, ready to ask difficult questions and deal with complicated scenarios! If you are creative and a problem solver, this is the place to be as will be supporting you to fast-forward your career!
We maximise each employee’s potential through personal development through a wide range of learning tools both formal and informal. We believe in remunerating our people with competitive salaries and a range of attractive benefits such as:
25 days’ holiday per year
1 additional day off for your Birthday
Annual wellness allowance
Share Purchase Plan
Medical Health Insurance
Medical Subscription (preventive medical services)
Life insurance
Pillar 3 Private Pension
Meal Vouchers
Flexible Benefits
Bookster
Volunteering Events
All LSEG colleagues with at least one year’s continuous service, who become parents, are now entitled to at least 26 weeks’ paid leave, and the option to return to work on a phased basis, in relation with specific company’s policy and guidelines
Career Stage:
Senior Associate
London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
Integrity, Partnership
,
Excellence
and
Change
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
